reviews.title: I have been waiting since the 3rd of…
reviews.body:
I have been waiting since the 3rd of November for Lebara to call me back to request for a replacement SIM card which I told I would get a call back within 24 48 hours i
I called and spoke to them today twice first time I was told I would get the call today 6th on priority. Called at 6:45pm now being told they can’t call back today wait another 24hrs 

Bad service from the staff who read from a script and never any to help 

Make out another department when they all share the same floor 

I would not recommend Lebara for you to keep your number on. No other network behaves this way when you want a replacement SIM card 

Awful network staff have bad attitude take all your details never call back 

If you are on Lebara I advise you to leave the network move to an established network like Vodafone, Three : EE or o2 

Lebara is a bad network

Then their customer service is excellent, I've just spoken to S Shama and she was great, a short wait, friendly and helpful. Finally, they make swapping to their Vodafone network so easy. reviews.title: Over a month of runaround, not blacklisting a stolen phone
reviews.body: After another week of runaround, Lebara still hasn’t blacklisted my stolen device. It is now over one month since my iPhone was stolen on holiday, and Lebara is treating me as someone else’s problem. They have refused to blacklist my stolen device and to provide me 'proof of usage' (I need both to claim against my travel insurance). The helpful public reply their Business Operations Director gave my review last week was all a front – he has not replied to my emails. Forget duty of care, Lebara is not interested in supporting their customer whose phone was stolen. I will not be renewing my monthly contract with them.
